knowledge/api.md:7:- **Leaderboard (HTML):** `https://api.start-hack.5u.ai/board`
knowledge/api.md:11:### Poll: `GET /v1/mailbox/messages?since_id=N&limit=1..200`
knowledge/api.md:15:- Everything arrives here: customer requests, carrier bids, rate desk answers, booking confirmations, airline tariff mails and tracking questions.
knowledge/api.md:26:`references` lists the thread's ids from the first mail down to the parent. `attachments` lists `id, filename, content_type, size`. Download each with `GET /v1/mailbox/messages/{id}/attachments/{attachment_id}`.
knowledge/api.md:28:`GET /v1/mailbox/messages/{id}` returns a single mail, **including mail we sent**. This is how we read our own outgoing quotes.
knowledge/api.md:30:### Send: `POST /v1/mailbox/messages`
knowledge/api.md:38:- Allowed recipients: customers, the airlines and truckers in `carrier-list.csv`, `ratedesk@hackloop.mail` and `tracking@hackloop.mail`. Any other address returns 422.
knowledge/api.md:113:- `GET /v1/board` is public: ranking, rounds and bookings.
knowledge/api.md:114:- `GET /v1/board/me` shows our verdict per request (`accepted`, `rejected`, `pending`, `open`, `no answer`, `voided`), the `reason` (e.g. `too_low`), and `booked`.
